subject: Hesai launches Kosmo spatial-data engine for robot training
summary: On 14 October, Hesai launched the previously previewed Kosmo One spatial camera and Kosmo World reconstruction cloud for robotics/world-model data. Partners named Galbot and Dexmal. The same release claimed more than 10,000 cumulative actuation modules delivered by end-Q2 2026. No independent sim-to-real validation, model portability or recurring platform revenue was disclosed. Hardware differentiation remains a live counterargument.
